verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a Research Agent that takes a research question, runs at a selectable effort level, pulls from many source types, and supports iteration. It also generates research reports automatically from any question, and its API can run a full systematic review end to end across search, screening, extraction and reporting. However, the evidence never explicitly describes the agent autonomously planning and running multiple investigation steps. The in-app Systematic Review is described as step-by-step guidance rather than autonomous execution, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of autonomous multi-step planning and execution by the Research Agent (e.g. iterative search, refine and synthesize loops), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step depth as opposed to single-pass summaries.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary

citations.quote: Every Research Agent session runs at an effort level, which you set from the slider in the prompt box before you send your question.
the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need
Enter any research question in Elicit to generate a research-backed report!
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers
